[[File:Pub.png|thumb|300px|right|[[John Marston]] enjoying a shot from [[Dewey Greenwood]].]]

'''Drinking''' is an [[Activities in Redemption 2|activity]] that plays an important social function in the American West, in which the ''[[Red Dead]]'' series takes place.

==''Red Dead Redemption''==
Players can buy a drink at their local [[saloon]] for two [[Money|dollars]]. However, depending on the player's decision during the [[Strangers|stranger]] side-mission "[[The Prohibitionist]]," this price can change in to either four dollars or one dollar. Furthermore, if Marston has obtained the [[fame]] rank of "Gunslinger", drinks will be free of charge at any bar, no matter the player's decision in "The Prohibitionist."

Alcoholic drinks, such as whiskey and bourbon, are more popular in the United States territories, while tequila is more popular in [[Nuevo Paraíso|Mexico]]. After the player drinks five or six times in a row, Marston will begin to stumble while walking, and falls very easily during a period of time. Sporadically, Marston gets blackouts, falling to the ground and lying still for some time. If Marston returns to the bar immediately after sobering up, it may take fewer drinks to get drunk once more. While drunk, the player must take caution, as it is very easy to upset a patron and get invited to a [[Dueling|duel]].

It should be noted that the sobering-up period can vary drastically from instance to instance. Marston may fall over once and then get back up sober, or it may take him more than a few minutes. It can take as little as ten seconds or as long as five minutes. Whether or not this depends on any certain factors is still unclear.

== ''Red Dead Redemption 2'' ==
[[File:A drunkard's guide to drunkenness.png|thumb|234x234px|A chart displaying the alcohol values of different consumables in the game.<ref>[[Red Dead Redemption II Complete Official Guide]]</ref>]]
The act of drinking is greatly expanded upon in ''Red Dead Redemption 2''. At any saloon, the player can purchase a bottle of beer or a shot of whiskey (which is typically more expensive than the former). Prices vary depending on the saloon. Players can also carry bottled beverages, found across the map and in local stores, in their [[satchel]] to consume at their leisure. This includes [[Aged Pirate Rum|aged pirate rum]], [[moonshine]], gin, [[Guarma]] rum, fine brandy, and Kentucky Bourbon. If the player wishes, they can also find crates of beer at the [[Van der Linde gang|gang]]'s [[Camps|camp]], behind [[Simon Pearson]]'s chuckwagon.

Like its predecessor, if the player drinks excessively, they will eventually become intoxicated. This will cast a filter on the player's screen to mimic the feeling of intoxication. Along with this, the player will walk drunkenly, and their dialogue with strangers and NPC's will be affected. If the player drinks too much, they may black out and wake up a few hours later. It should be noted that different beverages carry varying amounts of alcohol; drinks like beer will take the slowest to intoxicate the player, while aged pirate rum can automatically initiate drunkenness.

== Trivia ==
=== ''Red Dead Redemption'' ===
*Bartenders will not serve Marston if wearing the [[bandana]].
*To keep from falling, the player can tap A (Xbox 360), X (PlayStation 3 & 4), or B (Nintendo Switch) repeatedly. However, this will not stop Marston from eventually blacking out.
*Different spirits are requested randomly, and vary depending on the country Marston is in. Whiskey, bourbon, and gin are served in the USA; tequila and pulque are served in Mexico; rum and brandy are served in both countries. Regardless, bartenders always serve a nondescript bottle of brown liquor.
*When using the "Hic" [[Cheats|cheat]], Marston will remain drunk until the cheat is deactivated.
**If Marston has his weapon drawn before ordering a drink, he will draw it immediately after the player finishes drinking, even if he is drunk. This may cause other patrons to draw their weapons as a precaution.
**While his weapon is drawn in this state. Marston can enter [[Dead Eye Targeting]], even though he is unable to aim or shoot while he is drunk

=== ''Red Dead Redemption 2'' ===
*In saloons, beer always costs $0.50, but whiskey sometimes costs $1.
*Drinking interferes with the PS4 controls when the player is attacking a witness. Instead of the default punch button, the button for punch is R2 while drunk.
*If you pass out from drinking with a bounty, you will automatically end up in custody of the law and will wake up in jail.
